## Load packages

```{r}
c("here", "tidyverse", "Biostrings", "rtracklayer", "GenomicRanges") |>
  lapply(library, character.only = TRUE) |> invisible()

```

## Load functions

#Custom function from: https://github.com/Arthur-Oules/EJA_lcwgs_GenPop
```{r}

Get_outliers <- function(pcadapt,
                         method           = "bonferroni",
                         pvalue_threshold = .1,
                         minimize_length  = TRUE) {
  
  if (method == "bonferroni") {
    outliers_positions <- readRDS(file = here("data", "SNP_positions.rds")) |> 
      mutate(
        logpvalues = Get_pvalues(pcadapt),
        padj       = p.adjust(pcadapt$pvalues, method = "bonferroni") # Extract adjusted pvalues
      ) |>
      filter(padj < pvalue_threshold)  # Get outliers from pvalues
    
  } else if (method == "manual") {
    outliers_positions <- readRDS(file = here("data", "SNP_positions.rds")) |> 
      mutate( 
        pvalues    = pcadapt$pvalues,
        logpvalues = Get_pvalues(pcadapt)
      ) |> # Extract pvalues
      filter(is.na(pvalues) == FALSE) |> # Remove NAs
      filter(logpvalues >= pvalue_threshold)
    
  } else {
    stop("Method not recognized.")
  }
  
  print(paste0("There are ", as.character(dim(outliers_positions)[1]), " outliers SNPs."))
  
  if (isTRUE(minimize_length)&(dim(outliers_positions)[1]) > 34000) {
    outliers_positions <- outliers_positions |>
      arrange(desc(logpvalues), CHROM, POS) |> 
      filter(row_number() <= 34000) |> 
      arrange(CHROM, POS)
    
    print(paste0("Outliers number was reduced to 34.000 lowest pvalues."))
  }
  
  outliers_positions
}
```


## Outlier detection
````{r}
pcadapt_lcwgs_all <- read_rds(here("output", "pcadapt_lcwgs_all_K2.rds"))

SNP_positions <- readRDS(file = here("data", "SNP_positions.rds"))

outliers <- Get_outliers(pcadapt_lcwgs_all, pvalue_threshold = 1e-300) |> 
  left_join(
    SNP_positions %>% mutate(SNP_index = row_number()) %>% select(CHROM, POS, SNP_index),
    by = c("CHROM", "POS")
  ) |> 
  mutate(
    pval = pcadapt_lcwgs_all$pvalues[SNP_index]
  ) %>% 
  select(CHROM, POS, pval)

write_csv(outliers, "all_k2_outliers_1E300.csv")

````


## Load reference: the FASTA your lcWGS reads were originally mapped to
```{r}

ref <- readDNAStringSet(here("data", "GMI_no_contaminants.fasta"))
names(ref)

window <- 250

extract_window <- function(CHROM, POS, window = 250) {
  seq <- ref[[CHROM]]       # this is a DNAString
  seqlen <- length(seq)     # correct for DNAString
  
  start <- max(1, POS - window)
  end   <- min(seqlen, POS + window)
  
  subseq(seq, start = start, end = end)
}

```


## Extract read windows
```{r}
# use only CHROM and POS for extraction
seqs <- pmap(
  outliers[, c("CHROM", "POS")],
  \(CHROM, POS) extract_window(CHROM, POS)
)

# append p-value to names
names(seqs) <- paste0(
  outliers$CHROM,
  "_pos", outliers$POS
)

#saving fasta windows for outliers
writeXStringSet(
  DNAStringSet(seqs),
  "all_outlier_windows_1E300.fasta"
)
```


## BLAST batch loop against ocal Periophthalmus (mudskipper) genome database
```{r}

seqs <- readDNAStringSet("all_outlier_windows_1E300.fasta")

batch_size <- 1000
n_batches <- ceiling(length(seqs)/batch_size)


blast_db <- "/Users/asawkins/BLAST/db/Periophthalmus"

out_dir <- here("output", "blast_batches")
dir.create(out_dir, showWarnings = FALSE)

# Loop over batches
for(i in seq_len(n_batches)){
  start <- (i-1)*batch_size + 1
  end   <- min(i*batch_size, length(seqs))
  
  batch_file <- file.path(out_dir, paste0("batch_", i, ".fasta"))
  writeXStringSet(seqs[start:end], filepath = batch_file)
  
  out_file <- file.path(out_dir, paste0("blast_results_batch_", i, ".tsv"))
  
  system2(
  "/usr/local/ncbi-blast/bin/blastn",
    args = c(
      "-query", batch_file,
      "-db", blast_db,
      "-out", out_file,
      "-outfmt", "'6 qseqid sseqid pident length mismatch gapopen qstart qend sstart send evalue bitscore'",
      "-max_target_seqs", "5",
      "-num_threads", "4" 
  )
  )
}

# Read and combine results
blast_files <- list.files(out_dir, pattern = "blast_results_batch_.*\\.tsv$", full.names = TRUE)

blast_hits <- lapply(blast_files, function(f){
  read.table(f, sep = "\t", header = FALSE, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
}) |> bind_rows()

colnames(blast_hits) <- c(
  "qseqid","sseqid","pident","length","mismatch",
  "gapopen","qstart","qend","sstart","send","evalue","bitscore"
)

head(blast_hits)

```

## Filter Blast hits 
```{r}

blast_filt <- blast_hits %>%
  filter(
    evalue <= 1e-10, #guards against random matches
    pident >= 80, #percent identity
    length >= 200 #bp length
  )

```

## Keep Best hit per query
```{r}
best_hits <- blast_filt %>%
  arrange(qseqid, evalue, desc(bitscore)) %>%
  group_by(qseqid) %>%
  dplyr::slice(1) %>%
  ungroup()

```


## Import GFF annotation
```{r}

# Import annotation
gff <- import(here("Periophthalmus", "genomic.gff"))

# Keep only gene features
genes <- gff[gff$type == "gene"]

```


## Fix mismatch between sseqid and name of genes in gff:
```{r}
# Clean contig names to match annotation
best_hits <- best_hits %>%
  mutate(sseqid_clean = gsub("^ref\\||\\|$", "", sseqid))

# Ensure start <= end
sstart_fixed <- pmin(best_hits$sstart, best_hits$send)
send_fixed   <- pmax(best_hits$sstart, best_hits$send)


```


## Annotate outliers
```{r}

# --- Convert best_hits to GRanges ---
best_gr <- GRanges(
  seqnames = gsub("^ref\\||\\|$", "", best_hits$sseqid), # clean contig names
  ranges   = IRanges(start = sstart_fixed, end = send_fixed),
  strand   = "*"
)
mcols(best_gr) <- best_hits  # keep all blast info

# --- Import  gene annotation 
genes <- gff[gff$type == "gene"]

# --- Find overlaps between outlier windows and genes ---
hits_genes <- findOverlaps(best_gr, genes)

# --- Combine info into a table ---
annotated_hits <- tibble(
  qseqid      = best_gr$qseqid[queryHits(hits_genes)],
  sseqid      = best_gr$seqnames[queryHits(hits_genes)],
  gene_ID     = genes$ID[subjectHits(hits_genes)],
  gene_name   = genes$Name[subjectHits(hits_genes)],
  description = genes$description[subjectHits(hits_genes)],
  pident      = best_gr$pident[queryHits(hits_genes)],
  evalue      = best_gr$evalue[queryHits(hits_genes)],
  bitscore    = best_gr$bitscore[queryHits(hits_genes)]
)

# --- Check results ---
head(annotated_hits)
nrow(annotated_hits)  # how many outlier windows got annotated

# --- Save for downstream analysis ---
write_csv(annotated_hits, here("output", "outlier_windows_annotated_best_hits.csv"))

```


## Count how many outlier windows hit each gene
```{r}
gene_summary <- annotated_hits %>%
  group_by(gene_ID, gene_name, description) %>%   # group by gene
  summarise(
    n_hits = n(),               # count how many windows hit this gene
    max_pident = max(pident),   # optional: max percent identity
    min_evalue = min(evalue),   # optional: best e-value
    max_bitscore = max(bitscore) # optional: best bitscore
  ) %>%
  arrange(desc(n_hits))          # sort by most hits
```


## Retrieve Protein IDs
```{r}

# Load genome 
genome <- readDNAStringSet(here("Periophthalmus", "GCF_009829125.3_fPerMag1.2.pri_genomic.fna"))
names(genome) <- sapply(strsplit(names(genome), " "), `[`, 1)

# Load annotation
gff <- import(here("Periophthalmus", "genomic.gff"))

# Subset to CDS
cds <- gff[gff$type == "CDS"]

# Find overlapping CDS
hits_cds <- findOverlaps(best_gr, cds)

# Extract the CDS that overlap each hit
overlapping_cds <- cds[subjectHits(hits_cds)]

# Get protein IDs for each hit
protein_ids <- overlapping_cds$protein_id

# Add to your best_hits table
best_hits$protein_id <- NA
best_hits$protein_id[queryHits(hits_cds)] <- protein_ids


write_csv(best_hits, here("output", "protein_coding_best_hits.csv"))

```


## Retrieve AA seqs: KEGG Koala
```{r}

# --- Load the protein FASTA ---
proteins <- readAAStringSet(here("Periophthalmus", "protein.faa"))
names(proteins) <- sapply(strsplit(names(proteins), " "), `[`, 1)


# ---  Subset to your best hits ---
# Assuming best_hits$sseqid contains the protein IDs from BLAST
aa_hits <- proteins[names(proteins) %in% best_hits$protein_id]

# --- Inspect first few sequences ---
aa_hits[1:5]

# ---  Save to a FASTA file ---
writeXStringSet(aa_hits, here("output", "best_hit_proteins.fasta"))


```
